# CANDIDATE: VIX_LOW_ORB_BREAK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When VIX is low (<15) and price breaks above the opening range high with VWAP support, momentum tends to persist due to reduced expected volatility. This setup captures the edge of low-volatility breakouts that are more likely to trend without immediate reversal, particularly in the morning session when institutional participation is highest.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: VIX < 15 AND price > OR_high (first 30‑min high) AND price > VWAP AND candle close > OR_high AND volume > 1.5 * average_volume_first_30min.  
Exit shape: Initial stop at OR_low (chart‑stop) or ATR‑based stop; take profit at 1.5R then trail remainder with a chandelier exit (2.5×ATR).  
Regime hint: Best in low‑VIX (<15) morning session (09:30‑11:30); avoid high VIX (>25) or scheduled news.
